conclusion: The takeover itself is sound and fully verified, but the round is parked BLOCKED on one inherited build defect that T09's authorization does not cover. protoc-gen-go-redact@v0.0.0-20260831125122-5bb4931991b2 is now an ordinary package of go-wind-admin: the redact Proto has exactly one source (api/localdeps/redact), the runtime pb is generated exactly once into pkg/localdeps/go-wind-toolkit/protoc-gen-go-redact/redact/v1, the plugin is built from repository sources into tools/bin and is the only plugin Buf can reach during the post-change generation, and the 8 redact consumers in api/gen/go changed by 16 +/- lines that are all import strings. Reproducibility, descriptor equivalence, option survival and the real HTTP redaction path are all proven. BLOCKED because placing the upstream generator's own tests byte-identically introduces a module-wide build failure that did not exist at accepted_head: go vet ./... and go test ./... now fail in pkg/localdeps/go-wind-toolkit/protoc-gen-go-redact with the exact error the unmodified upstream archive produces (redactor_test.go:116:23: undefined: redact). That is not an import-string rewrite of an existing string, and the goal names only imports.go and process.go as editable, so it was validated in a throwaway copy and deliberately NOT applied here. Deleting the tests, excluding the package, or shipping a permanently failing go test ./... are all rejected as gate-lowering. See decision_needed.
